title: Felipe Khoury Kalil
text:
I am a MSc. student in Plasma Physics and I am working on developing the new magnetic diagnostics system for the TCABR upgrade at the Plasma Physics Laboratory of University of São Paulo (USP).
This website has some cool articles with interactive simulations I have created (and still am creating) in my free time (always under construction!). You can also view and download my CV. And you can reach out to me via  LinkedIn.
